english.title: Licence holder employ a person under 18 years of age in a sex establishment
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a licence for a sex establishment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE ESTABLISHMENT..), employed **(..SPECIFY THE NAME..), a person known to you to be under 18 years of age in the business of that establishment
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 23(1)(b) and (2) of Schedule 3 to the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1982.
